notes.title: Game Update v2.0.1
notes.content:
Major game update version 2.0.1

In this update I have added new equipment and clothing interfaces, as well as more items to the shop.
You can now purchase and equip different clothing which effect your visibility to the animals.

Weapons have been updated. I have removed the self sight adjustment feature. Weapons are all calibrated by default now.

Reward prices have also been adjusted to better balance the game play.

Map fixes have been made to the terrain in a few places as there were some bugs.

A new saving system has been added to accommodate the new items that have been added. This unfortunately resulted in old saved games not being compatible with this new version.

- Added "Owned" text to Shop item and displaying "owned" if you already own that piece of equipment or weapon.
- Added Save option to the credits screen at game completion.

notes.title: Patch 1.16 released
notes.content:
Path 1.16 Released.

The patch contains the following changes and updates.

- Renamed "Bag:??/??" on bottom of the main user interface, to "Kills:??/??"
- Updated damage per bone. Not all bones had damage multiplier values. This made killing them very challenging.
- Changed collision on Fences. You can now shoot through fences.
- Changed bait prices
- Move bait placement further out.
- Fixed a problem where the aim camera will move through collision objects.
- Reduced the size of the Rabbits slightly
- Added information to the item details window, showing what animals the bait will attract.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch Update 1.14
notes.content:
Game patched to version 1.14

This is a slightly bigger updated to the previous one. The following fixes and changes have been applied.

- Updated Shoot position
- Updated mission log User interface 
- Added Tip of the day
- Play level save added to only save play level progress without effecting current game play progression.
- Fixed a problem with the Scope Zoom randomly getting stuck.
- Added Scope Sight Adjustments separate from no scope adjustments and the saving of the data.
- Moved Target on shooting range, closer and removed the shine on it.
- Modified Tip of the day information and display logic
- Adjusted Damage per bone to be more realistic.
- Added a note to the general settings screen informing the user that a game restart is required to load the changes.
- Added a class array for vermin to be killed per mission, and only these vermin will effect the kill count.
- Added some furniture to farm house
- Added a few more missions.
- Moved some missions around to assist in progression.

Enjoy!
